name: pr-ci-watch
description: After a git push or create_pull_request, checks the branch's PR every 2 minutes and wakes the session once its CI has finished (naming failures), when no checks register, when CI runs past an hour, or when the PR merges or closes. After enable_pr_auto_merge it keeps watching until the PR merges and wakes if it is green but not merged within 30 minutes, naming why (LC-1975).
